title: Maze Simulator
description: Generates, solves, and visualizes mazes using BFS, DFS, Prim's, and Kruskal's. Includes step-by-step algorithm visualization.
features: Maze generation with Prim's and Kruskal's minimum-spanning-tree algorithms
Pathfinding and traversal with breadth-first and depth-first search
Step-by-step visualization of each algorithm's progress
Adjustable grid size and animation speed

title: Competitive Programming Math
description: A web and mobile handbook of the math behind competitive programming — GCD and LCM, sieves, binary exponentiation, number theory, combinatorics, and game theory — with step-by-step interactive algorithm traces. Built and used while volunteering as a competitive programming instructor.
features: Reference pages for 25+ competitive-programming math topics
Step-by-step interactive traces of algorithms such as the Euclidean GCD
C++ implementations shown alongside each explanation
Interactive tools for binary exponentiation, GCD, and the Sieve of Eratosthenes
One Expo codebase running on web and mobile
